# Synthetic legacy reporter oracle

These are offline, hand-authored fixtures, not past model executions. Each input
contains one scenario, one run for each variant, and four synthetic assistant
turns per run. The scenario suite, rubric, and four-turn reporter thresholds are
unchanged. Mock manifest isolation fields do not assert that a real launcher or
server ran. The model and CLI-version strings are explicitly fake.

The expected `report-v1.json`, `report-v2.json`, and `report-v3.json` bytes were
written by the original `scripts/grilling-eval/core.mjs`, copied before F1-F3
implementation from HEAD `2d3b0a1025abca23ad065e26e126354f55d0b19b`.
`provenance.json` records that source's SHA-256, all three expected report digests,
and the original result schema v1-v3 and benchmark v1-v11 hashes. Expected reports
were not regenerated with the updated reporter. The original writer also
verified that repeated writes retain the digest and differing existing report
bytes raise `OUTPUT_CONFLICT`.

Each `input-vN.json` bundles a benchmark object, a comparison object, and an
`artifacts` map of relative paths to exact text. Tests materialize those bytes
only inside a new owned temporary directory. Its `comparison/comparison.json`
contains canonical JSON for `comparison`; its `benchmark.json` contains
canonical JSON for `benchmark`. The expected report is the separately stored
file, not output generated by the test's current writer.

The v1 fixture has no explicit reasoning effort, and v1/v2 lack repository Skill
proof fields. Their frozen reports preserve the original condition failures and
`fail` gate. The v3 synthetic fixture has matching mocked requested conditions
and a `pass` gate. These historical gates and `exactModel` fields retain the old
reporter's meaning; none proves an observed model or effective server effort.

Run `node --test test/grilling-eval-legacy.test.mjs` to check reader immutability,
exact report bytes and SHA-256, original conflict handling, original v2/v3 effort
enums, and historical schema/benchmark bytes. Do not update these expectations
using the current reporter to make a regression pass.
